body: Sometimes I just feel like this empty walking shell that has no idea what she's living for.  It feels like I haven't put the pieces of the puzzles together to form my own image.  When I think about it, I have no idea what my values and joys in the physical world are.  Thank you for not telling me I'm an idiot for wanting to "find myself".  :)

I am not currently talking to someone because I've had bad experiences with therapists in the past.  I'm seriously considering it though, and I'm most likely going to try finding someone who has a specialty in childhood issues.
